Shipping & returns

Free US shipping on FW26 pieces and masks. Masks ship everywhere we ship: free in the US, and one flat USPS rate per order abroad, shown at checkout. Canada, the UK, Germany, Australia, Japan and South Korea ship for a flat per-item fee shown at checkout. Pillows ship to the US only. MagSafe cases can’t ship to Japan or South Korea. South Korea orders need the buyer’s Personal Customs Clearance Code (PCCC).

Duties and taxes may apply on delivery and are the buyer’s responsibility. Shipping isn’t refunded on refused parcels.
